composition_rules: Use only solver-native raster/EPS science layers; the reference crops are QA only.
No external redrawing of vectors, cell polygons, contours or data colours.
Uniform scale of native scientific viewports only; match world bounds and equal x/y physical scale before placement.
Native colour strips retain original RGB values and scalar range; labels may be re-typeset outside the native data area.
Keep every overall target box exactly, including the 143 mm Figure6 stack and 160x74 mm Figure2.
